title: Peruvian-Style Grilled Chicken with Green Sauce
description: Peruvian-style grilled chicken marinated in a spice-vinegar rub and served with a creamy cilantro jalapeño green sauce. Bold, tangy, and smoky.

steps.instruction: Make the green sauce: blend jalapeños, ají amarillo, cilantro, garlic, mayo, sour cream, lime juice, and vinegar until smooth.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while blending until emulsified. Season with salt and pepper and refrigerate.
Spatchcock the chicken by removing the backbone and flattening the bird.
Mix salt, cumin, paprika, pepper, garlic, vinegar, and oil into a paste and coat the chicken evenly.
Preheat grill (charcoal or gas) and set up two-zone heat.
Grill chicken skin-side up on cooler side until internal temp reaches about 110°F.
Flip to hotter side and press down to crisp skin, cooking until 145–150°F internally.
Rest chicken for 5–10 minutes, then carve and serve with green sauce.
